name: spp-make-prompts
title_zh: 计划书先过三道审查再拆成执行提示词
tagline_zh: PLAN.md 别急着动手。先按 SDD、TDD、代码审查三副眼镜逐条过，漏掉的设计缺口当场拦下。
tagline_en: Got a PLAN.md? It runs SDD, TDD, and code-review lenses over it first, catches design gaps, then generates.
desc_en: Use when a PLAN.md exists and the user wants to generate to_do_prompts/{feature_name}_prompts/ — reviews the plan through superpowers execution-stage lenses (SDD, TDD, code-review) before calling /make-prompts. Trigger: /spp-make-prompts, "계획서 기반 프롬프트 만들어줘", "spp-make-prompts 수행".
why_zh: 不是翻译计划书，是先用执行阶段透镜审一遍：设计是否可测、测试是否可码、代码是否可审。三关都过才放行。
why_en: It doesn't translate the plan — it audits it through execution-stage lenses. If a step isn't testable or reviewable, you'll know.
limit_zh: 只认 PLAN.md 且只产出 to_do_prompts/{feature_name}_prompts/ 下的提示词…
limit_en: Only handles PLAN.md → to_do_prompts/{feature_name}_prompts/. No code, no tests, no plan edits. Missing steps in the plan won't be invented.
title_en: Plan reviewer that gates before splitting into prompts
